nom: Rael Miracle Clear Complete Acne Serum

avis.texte: I'm on my 4th bottle of this serum and it has done wonders on my skin! I use a generous amount of it every night after a double cleanse and it has improved my skin texture and decreased my breakouts. Even my esthetician has noticed a significant improvement in my skin texture and hydration level, and I attribute it to this serum at night, and a hyaluronic acid serum in the morning. This will continue to be a staple repurchase for me.

The Rael Acne Serum is my go-to for tackling breakouts quickly and effectively. It calms inflammation and reduces redness without drying out my skin. Since I started using it, my acne has noticeably cleared up!

I really like this product! It can be used both morning and night. It doesn't pill under makeup or with other skincare. This serum helps clear acne and doesn't cause any breakouts. The dropper can be hard to get a lot of product out, but the product itself is great!

Had a rough week with my skin and was breaking out with bumps on my face but consistent use with this serum for a week now and my skin is beginning to heal and clear up. My forehead was bumpy but now noticibly flat and skin is becoming even again. Gentle and didnt feel irritation.

my skin is sensitive and easily overexfoliated, so i was a little concerned about using an all over serum rather than a spot treatment. however, i was struggling with multiple breakouts and congestion after a new cleansing routine and tried this serum in the morning under moisturizer. it seems to have made my acne smaller without making my skin flaky. the tip of my nose is a little bit irritated but not as much as it would be with other salicylic acid treatments. overall i would continue to use in conjunction with some soothing products.
Love this product it exfoliates and moisturizes at the same time such a great product

avis.titre: Gets your skin back to where it should be!
avis.texte: I've tried a lot of products and a lot of them don't live up to what they say, but but this one it actually does what it says it's gonna do! i've dealt with a lot of hormonal, acne around my chin and cheeks, and the turnover rate has been a lot more faster than with other products

avis.titre: Helps clear my skin so much!
avis.texte: This product has helped me with stubborn black heads and my skin texture so much!

I tried this serum and have been using it for a little under a week. Ive seen major changes in my skin, and for the better! Smaller zits and fewer black heads! It has also helped me with my oily skin. I am no where as oily as I usually am!

I was so impressed after using this on my 17 year olds face who struggles with constant breakouts. After clesnsing, we put this on and i was impressed at how much his surface redness had toned down! After four consistent days of use, his skin is waaaay less red, there are no new breakouts and i can see a DEFINITE improvement in the active acne on his skin. The redness improved immediately and more so each day but im also pleased to see a drastic improvement in the texture of his skin as well. Im excited that i found a product that he notices a difference with as well! Ive tried so many things and nothing seemed to work and i couldnt get him to be consistent. But i think seeing a difference so soon gave him huge motivation to keep with it everyday.
This product has been working great for my acne. It will definitely be a part of my regular routine!
I have been using this product for about 2 months and my skin has been looking amazing and glowy

I recieved Rael's Acne serum in exchange for a review. I was excited to try this product. As a man, I struggle with blackheads, whiteheads, acne, and hormonal acne, espescially where I grow facial hair. I've tried other BHA serums before but they always caused more irritation without any benefits. This is the first BHA serum with Salicylic acid that quickly cleared my skin without long term use or any irritation! My only con is the packaging is very cheap. The dropper is made from plastic, and the suction on the applicator is very weak. It takes a lot more effort. I wish the packaging was glass as it tends to be more sanitary for serums.

avis.titre: Safe for my sensitive and eczema prone skin.
avis.texte: I bought this two weeks ago and OMG — it has worked wonders. I had stubborn blemishes, acne, and blackheads on my cheeks. Since I have sensitive, eczema-prone skin, I was super reluctant to try this because I've had bad reactions to products like it before. But nope! This actually improved not just my blemishes, but also the redness on both of my cheeks. I also tried some of their other products and honestly, hands down the best decision I've ever made. I love that it has a milky thicker texture because it makes me feel like it's actually doing something on my skin without being drying, or causing irritation or redness. I do feel that if you aren't used to actives you need to start slowly with this serum, as overdoing it can eventually cause a little bit of burning/irritation. I use this product once a day at night time and occasionally twice a day during my period cycle when acne is more prevalent. Can feel a little sticky at first, but it leaves my skin feeling plump and refreshed. LOVE and HIGHLY recommend!
